jobs.description: PolyTALENT ist auf die Besetzung von Fach- und Führungspositionen im industriellen Mittelstand spezialisiert. Wir kombinieren modernste digitale Prozesse und KI-gestützte Tools mit persönlicher, verbindlicher Beratung. Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir hungrige Persönlichkeiten, die Menschen begeistern können und echten Drive mitbringen, unabhängig davon, was auf Deinem bisherigen Zeugnis steht. Du kommst aus der Gastronomie, dem Einzelhandel, der Versicherungsbranche oder dem Vertrieb , hast richtig Bock auf Erfolg und suchst nach einer Perspektive mit exzellenten, ungedeckelten Verdienstmöglichkeiten im B2B-Umfeld? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Deine Benefits bei uns Sicheres Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision – Dein Fleiß und Deine Erfolge bestimmen maßgeblich Dein Einkommen. 30 Tage Urlaub für die wohlverdiente Auszeit als fairer Ausgleich zu Deiner Performance. Strukturiertes Onboarding inklusive Einarbeitung in Recruiting, Active Sourcing und Kandidatenmanagement. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit Apple MacBook und ergonomischem Setup ab dem ersten Tag. Digitale Tools und KI-Unterstützung für effiziente Suche, Ansprache und Prozesssteuerung. Kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für High-Performer, bis hin zu mehr Verantwortung im Kunden- oder Teamaufbau. Deine Aufgaben Active Sourcing über LinkedIn, XING und weitere digitale Kanäle zur Identifikation passender Fach- und Führungskräfte. Erstansprache und Vorqualifizierung von Kandidaten im telefonischen und schriftlichen Austausch. Führung strukturierter Interviews zur Bewertung von Motivation, Wechselbereitschaft und fachlicher Passung. Steuerung des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses von der Suche bis zur Vertragsunterschrift. Beratung unserer B2B-Kunden zu Kandidatenprofilen, Marktfeedback und Prozessgeschwindigkeit. Aufbau und Pflege von Talentpools , Netzwerken und langfristigen Kandidatenbeziehungen. Dein Profil Erfahrung im Recruiting, Active Sourcing, Vertrieb, Sales, Account

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner - Product & Tech (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description: Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York. We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective. About the role As our (Senior) HR Business Partner for Product & Tech, you will join Vestiaire Collective on a fixed-term basis to provide maternity leave cover and ensure continuity across the Product & Tech organisation. The expected duration of the assignment is 12 months starting January. You will act as a trusted strategic partner to our Product & Tech leaders, managers and employees, helping them build high-performing, engaged and effective teams. You will work closely with leaders on organisational design, talent management, performance, succession planning, leadership development and employee engagement. This is a hands-on and autonomous role combining strategic business partnering with ownership of recurring people processes and cross-functional projects. You will support a global Product & Tech population and work closely with People Operations, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, Compensation and Legal to deliver consistent and effective people solutions. Based in our Berlin office and reporting to the Chief People Officer, you will join a team of five HR Business Partners working together to support Vestiaire Collective’s global organisation. jobs.description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Providing oversight of human resource (HR) functions including: Organizational Effectiveness, Workforce Planning and Talent Management, Total Rewards, Employee Relations, and Health and Wellness in a global, shared services context. Provide support and guidance to people leaders to ensure consistency with the organization's overall HR strategy. Key Responsibilities Implement organizational structure, enhance employee engagement, lead cultural and change management initiatives (particularly for EU integration), and diagnose/resolve team dysfunction. Measure talent gaps, execute workforce plans, oversee the full talent acquisition lifecycle, and ensure employer branding aligns with organizational objectives. jobs.title: Staffing Associate (Contract)
jobs.description: About Invisible Invisible is an Applied AI research company closing the gap between frontier models and the enterprise. We provide the platform infrastructure that makes AI work in production at scale: unify fragmented data, map complex processes, orchestrate and evaluate agents, and stand up hyper-personalized workflow applications fast for companies like Grubhub, Alliance Global, and Thomson Reuters. Where models fall short, we build RL environments and data to fix them. The result: a virtuous cycle between enterprise deployment and model training. Recognized as Best Predictive Analytics Platform of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards, Invisible makes AI work. About The Role The Staffing Associate at Invisible Technologies gets qualified experts onto client projects and billing fast. Our Staff Aug team places niche specialists across a wide range of industries and disciplines, and the profile can be anything a client needs that week. Working with the Senior Manager, Strategic Staffing, you'll turn client demand into staffed, productive teams: sourcing and vetting contractors, matching them to the right engagement, and moving them through onboarding to their first billed client hour. The work is more closely aligned to a talent marketplace and gig recruiting than to traditional headhunting, with very high volumes, hard-to-find profiles and quick turnarounds. This is a 6-month, 40-hour-per-week contract with potential to extend or convert. The Staff Aug function launched recently and is growing quickly, so you'll help shape how the team works as well as staff its projects. It suits a fast, tech-forward staffing professional who has run high-volume, niche staffing in a marketplace-style model, measures success in fill rates and billed hours, and thrives on urgency. jobs.description: Die Daikin Refrigerants Frankfurt GmbH mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main ist eine 100 %ige Tochter der Daikin Chemical Europe GmbH und damit der Daikin Industries Ltd., mit Sitz in Osaka Japan, zugehörig. Die Daikin Gruppe mit weltweit über 100.000 Mitarbeitern ist ein führender Hersteller von Klima- und Kühlgeräten sowie von fluorhaltigen Chemikalien. Neben einer Anlage zur Feindestillation des Pharma-Treibmittels S227 Pharma, welches weltweit in Dosier-Aerosolen für die Verabreichung medizinischer Wirkstoffe (e.g. Sprays gegen Asthma und COPD) eingesetzt wird, betreibt Daikin seit 2020 auch eine Aufbereitungsanlage zur Reinigung rückgewonnener fluorierter technischer Gase (HFKW), so dass diese anschließend erneut zum Einsatz in Klima- und Kühlgeräten eingesetzt werden können. Zudem verfügt der Standort über eine thermische Spaltanlage zur schadlosen Entsorgung von FCKW, HFKW und FKW. Mittels Wasserstoff-Sauerstoffflamme werden die Gase in Spaltreaktoren zu Fluss- und Salzsäure umgewandelt und als Rohstoffe wieder in den Wertstoffkreislauf zurückgeführt. jobs.title: (Senior) Recruiter - Growing Impact Scale Up
jobs.description: Join us in Revolutionizing Supply Chains We’re a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to shape a sustainable future for the food industry. With four years of continuous 100% year-on-year growth, our team is expanding quickly. We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Recruiter to help us find the people who will drive that growth, and to help shape how we work as we scale. Join us and shape the future of food sustainability with us! About Simvia Ensuring responsible supply chains is one of the largest challenges of our time. At Simvia we are on a path to enable the food and consumer goods industry to become a force for good, by making it simple to prove that what we eat and use is safe, compliant, and sustainable. Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. AI gives us a strong tailwind: our network holds unique data, and much of the manual work in compliance can now be automated. We are growing rapidly and keep scaling with a driven, international team of 75+ people in the heart of Amsterdam. About this role You will be our first in-house Recruiter. There is no recruitment playbook yet, so you build it: the process, the guardrails and the habits that let us hire fast and well as we scale. That calls for someone who thinks "I'll find a way" rather than "what's the rule here?" Sourcing is the heart of the job. Most of your impact comes from finding and convincing great people who were not looking. Every person you bring in shapes the company we become, so we want someone who lives our culture, not only someone who can describe it. Who thrives here Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. Open. You ask for feedback
